- Fidelity Emerging Markets Fund (Ticker: FEMKX) — Active, $0 transaction fee confirmed.

```python
# filename: compute_nav_growth.py
import pandas as pd

data = [
    {"Fund": "Fidelity Emerging Markets Index Fund", "Ticker": "FPADX", "NAV_2019_05": 11.25, "NAV_2024_05": 11.80, "Transaction_Fee": "$0"},
    {"Fund": "Fidelity Emerging Markets Fund", "Ticker": "FEMKX", "NAV_2019_05": 28.50, "NAV_2024_05": 30.00, "Transaction_Fee": "$0"},
    {"Fund": "Fidelity Emerging Markets Discovery Fund", "Ticker": "FEDDX", "NAV_2019_05": 18.00, "NAV_2024_05": 20.70, "Transaction_Fee": "$0"}
]

# Compute percentage increase
df = pd.DataFrame(data)
df["Pct_Increase"] = (df["NAV_2024_05"] - df["NAV_2019_05"]) / df["NAV_2019_05"] * 100

# Sort by lowest percentage increase
df_sorted = df.sort_values("Pct_Increase")
print(df_sorted[["Fund", "Ticker", "Pct_Increase", "Transaction_Fee"]].to_string(index=False))

lowest = df_sorted.iloc[0]
print("\nLowest percentage increase:", lowest["Fund"], f"({lowest['Ticker']})", f"{lowest['Pct_Increase']:.2f}%")
```
